description: This file implements the CertIssuerSourceAia class, which fetches issuer certificates via the Authority Information Access (AIA) extension in X.509 certificates. It includes functions for parsing certificates from DER, CMS, and PEM formats, and manages asynchronous fetch requests to retrieve issuer certificates from specified URLs.

classes.name: AiaRequest
classes.description: Handles asynchronous requests to fetch issuer certificates from URLs specified in the AIA extension.

methods.name: ParseCertFromDer
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded certificate and adds it to the results list.

methods.name: ParseCertsFromCms
methods.description: Parses certificates from a CMS (PKCS#7) message.

methods.name: AiaRequest::GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next available issuer certificates from ongoing fetch requests.

methods.name: AiaRequest::AddCertFetcherRequest
methods.description: Adds a new fetch request to the queue.

methods.name: AiaRequest::AddCompletedFetchToResults
methods.description: Processes completed fetch results, parsing fetched bytes into certificates.

methods.name: CertIssuerSourceAia::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Synchronous method to get issuer certificates (not used).

methods.name: CertIssuerSourceAia::AsyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous fetch of issuer certificates based on AIA URLs in a certificate.
